external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and browser sign-in.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company that connects to the loyalty platform.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.
processes.notes: The app's PKCE behavior is not documented.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, handles authorization flows, issues tokens, and maintains authorization state.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API called by clients to access and modify loyalty points and redeem gift cards.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: It does not check which client or audience a token was issued for.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application used to close a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Stores member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Stores every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Stores every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.authentication: one-hour signed JWT bearer access token
data_flows.data_description: access token and rewards API requests

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.authentication: client ID and client secret in request body

data_flows.name: approve consent
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The browser carries the redirect to the partner app's redirect URI.

data_flows.name: disconnect app
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: read and write ledger
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
data_flows.notes: Redeeming points for a gift card requires a valid access token carrying the redeem scope.

data_flows.name: write requests
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: The member's refresh tokens remain in the database.

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's own cloud account where the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: The members' phones, outside the organisation's cloud account, where the mobile app runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: apart from the members' phones and the partner apps

trust_boundaries.name: partner apps
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies that run the partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: partner apps that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies it as a mobile app rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The authorization server presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source describes an authorization-server sign-in page used in a browser.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies it as an API accessed over HTTPS.
The source says the rewards API is served on a public hostname.
The source says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
